summary: I am beginning to see blockchain not as a decentralized technology but one that is even more reliant on a single authority and system, but I am learning. Still I think there are much bigger problems in education than building a better database. #OpenBadges
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I am beginning to see blockchain not as a decentralized technology but one that is even more reliant on a single authority and system, but I am learning.

Still I think there are much bigger problems in education than building a better database. #OpenBadges
